component.name: Kaibo
component.summary: Go live on Bilibili from an OBS dock

description.p: Kaibo adds a dock to OBS Studio: sign in to Bilibili with a QR code, edit the room title, area and announcement, and go live in one click — Kaibo opens the room, writes the RTMP settings into OBS and starts streaming. It watches for dropped streams and mismatched room/stream states and offers the fix. Interface in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English.
